title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Make the same column editable or non-editable based on different conditions on the list page (Dynamic Editable Control for the Same Column)
summary: Make a column editable or non-editable on a list page based on row-specific conditions using a Boolean field and the Editable property. This is useful when different rows need different edit permissions without showing error messages.
key_points: Use a variable bound to the Editable property to conditionally control field editability
Update the variable in OnAfterGetRecord to reflect the condition for each row
Update the variable in OnValidate when the condition field changes
Fields remain non-editable from the start, no error messages required

quotes.text: they want a specific column to be editable only for rows that meet certain conditions, and non-editable for all other rows.
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the core requirement for conditional field editability based on row-level conditions

quotes.text: the field should simply be non-editable from the start.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains that the solution must prevent editing without triggering validation errors

quotes.text: you just need to control the Editable property using a variable.
quotes.why_it_matters: Provides the key implementation technique for achieving dynamic editability
